answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Each submission hangs on the nadir of a task receipt, and the comet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
